figures set out along a horizontal register/band
justification: The only real correspondence is that both surfaces show quadruped animals in profile arranged along a horizontal band, a near-universal motif; A's shallow incised animal is loosely comparable in schematic outline to B's linear figures. Otherwise the content diverges completely: B is dominated by long crewed boats with rows of stroke-crew and small human figures, none of which appear in A, while A's principal subject is a group of massive, rounded, three-dimensionally modelled beasts crowded together, a mode of depiction absent from B.
